title: Education occupancy codes
text:
Education occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following education
 occupancy class codes.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and
 limitations for specific models, refer to the model documentation that is available on
 the 
Client Portal
.

Note:
 The associated 2-digit Standard Industrial
 Classification (SIC) code or codes are listed for each occupancy code.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 345 | Universities, Colleges, and Technical Schools | 82 | Establishments providing academic or technical instruction. Also
 included are establishments providing educational services such as
 libraries, student exchange programs, and curriculum development. For all
 exposures in the U.S., Australia, Canada, South America, the Caribbean,
 Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for exposures covered for wind in
 Europe, use education code 34 for primary and secondary schools. In other
 regions, those occupancies are included in 345. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |
| 346 | Primary and Secondary Schools | 82 | Includes institutions engaged in instruction at primary and secondary
 level. Valid for all exposures in the U.S., Australia, Canada, South
 America, the Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, and for
 exposures covered for wind in Europe. In other regions, use education
 occupancy code 345 for these occupancies. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |
